run.layout: every section below criteria is a table: fields names the columns once, nested readings as dotted names, and rows holds one record per line in that order

flip.block lifted: 50 or more fewer: a block lifted
flip.block under: 50 or more nodes more below the floor than the twin at the close: a block knocked under
flip.one node: one node either way, inside A18_B6's jitter: no reading

kept.gone: first round outside the band and tail inside: the ratio is printed, and it is zero to within the band
kept.kept: first round and tail both outside the band on the same side: the ratio is printed; near 1 none of it has gone, above 1 it has widened
kept.late: first round inside the band and tail outside: the effect arrives after the first round, the ratio has no denominator and is not formed; the tail stands alone
kept.nothing: first round and tail both inside the band: nothing here to be kept or lost, the ratio is not formed. An arm that was never applied (a cap that never bit, a cut of no edge) is this state too, and is told apart by its own columns
kept.reversed: first round and tail outside the band on opposite sides: the ratio is negative, and both numbers are printed

lifted.back: the mean deviation over the last 10 rounds is inside the twin's band: the share is back where the twin's is
lifted.no band: the twin's share touches zero in the tail: no reading
lifted.not back: outside the band at the end, on the side it was on when the ceiling came off
lifted.nothing to give back: inside the band when the ceiling came off: the ceiling had moved nothing, so nothing is read
lifted.reversed: outside the band at the end, on the other side
